title: Interfaces
subtitle: Powerful Integration and Extension
descHeading: Seamless Data Exchange with Internal and External Systems
descContent: CSI has considerable experience in interfacing its solutions with a range of internal and external data sources to promote data sharing on multiple levels⏤local, regional, state, and federal. Without interfaces to exchange data across systems, redundant data entry, data silos, and duplicate entries are inevitable. With interfaces, agencies can access multiple systems from a single workstation, generate inquiries to other external or regional databases, submit data automatically or based on agency rules, and much more.

diagram.desc: CSI provides an adaptable and scalable total solution platform as well as expert interfacing on demand to facilitate interagency access and data sharing. Interfaces can be easily integrated into the existing InfoShare™ system depending on the unique requirements of each agency. Agencies can operate their own preferred systems and at the same time access data from external sources. To ensure data security, our interfacing capabilities are fully compliant with criminal justice standards including NIEM, GJ-XML, CJIS, and FIPS.

title: Data Sharing
subtitle: Break Down Information Silos to Promote Inter-Agency Collaboration
descHeading: Maximum interoperability and sharing of mission-critical information
descContent: Data silos prevent agencies from accessing data in a timely manner. They create separations between data sets across departments, agencies, and geographic jurisdictions. Our systems are designed to optimize the usage of data through expert interfacing, vertical integration, and cloud integration so that data flows smoothly and securely between systems in real-time. Seamless data sharing allows agencies to expand their situational awareness and collect every piece of the puzzle.

diagram.desc: CSI accomplishes data sharing in three ways: across agencies, across devices, and across products. Our enterprise application fulfills the need for accelerated data interoperability in the public sector. One of the biggest concerns with data sharing is security. But with our fully compliant security methodology, data breaches are the last thing government agencies need to worry about. Moreover, agencies can easily customize the extent of data transparency using robust permission settings to ensure only authorized users have access.

title: Data Migration
subtitle: Comprehensive, Structured Data Conversion Services
descHeading: Fully searchable, cleansed, and standardized legacy data
descContent: CSI uses an iterative development method to ensure that legacy data appears as if it was entered originally in the new system. Users don’t need to search a separate database or log in to a different system to access the legacy data. Everything is unified under one database in the InfoShare™ system. Over the years, CSI has developed a systematic data migration strategy and successfully converted legacy data for more than thirty systems.

diagram.desc: CSI offers the most structured and comprehensive data migration services on the market. We use a tried-and-tested proprietary process to analyze and transfer legacy data to the new system. The original data is not simply copied but also cleansed, condensed, and standardized. In InfoShare™, a unique person exists as a single consolidated record. Users never have to re-enter old data or remove duplicate entries. Some vendors create independent functions to access the legacy data, whereas others handle the data migration process with much less effort, resulting in inconsistent and messy data. By contrast, CSI develops tools and strategies to offer high quality data migration with data integrity assurance.

title: Cloud Integration
subtitle: Mature Hybrid Cloud-Ready Applications for Speed and Security
descHeading: Cloud-based software suite with scaled up resources, enhanced data sharing, and low-cost operations
descContent: CSI has considerable expertise in cloud migration services. We leverage the power of cloud computing to help agencies transfer their operations to CJIS-compliant cloud platforms. But CSI’s cloud integration isn’t limited to scaling up resources and improving government capabilities. InfoShare™ Cloud also enhances data sharing and application design. All products and modules within InfoShare™ are integrated and cloud-deployable, creating a cohesive enterprise application platform designed specifically for the unique needs of the public sector.

diagram.desc: InfoShare™ Cloud brings multiple cloud environments together to create scalable, reliable, and low-cost applications operating as a single, cohesive IT infrastructure. Our integration supports public, private, and hybrid cloud requirements hosted on the CJIS-compliant AWS GovCloud or Azure Government—both designed for maximum government security. Traditional application integration is complex, expensive, and not to mention, resource-intensive. They typically lack flexibility and have limited storage. CSI’s cloud integration with robust security authentication and permission policies yields many advantages including scalability, unlimited storage, improved performance, enhanced user experience, and substantial cost savings in maintenance and deployment.

descContent: U.S. Patent 10,649,743 B2 entitled "Application Developing Method and System" was designed to facilitate and streamline application development for government agencies and beyond. The patent removes complexity from building modern applications that can be easily and quickly adapted to fulfill each agency’s missions and requirements.

title: Security
subtitle: Robust Data Encryption, Permission, and Protection
descHeading: Integrated security methodology compliant with industry security standards
descContent: CSI’s security policy ensures continuity of criminal justice information protection, from creation through dissemination, at rest or in transit and passes the stringent third-party penetration test. Integrated GovCloud security features are fully compliant with CJIS (Criminal Justice Information Services), FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards), IRS Safeguards Audit, and other government security standards.

diagram.desc: Effective security methodology eliminates security risks and vulnerabilities defined in Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 to ensure that sensitive criminal justice information is fully protected. Traditional applications lack robust security controls and are vulnerable to SQL injection, XSS, and other attacks. With integrated government cloud security features and strict authority control, CSI’s security mechanism is fully compliant with CJIS rules, FIPS, IRS Safeguards Audit Requirements, and other national security requirements.

descContent: U.S. Patent 10,706,225 B2 “Form Management System and Method” converts existing paper forms into web-based electronic forms with all layout information and corresponding fields and data types stored in a common library. Users can maintain form layouts, edit input fields, set element types, design dropdown lists, create access permissions, and export the forms to various formats. diagram.desc: Electronic forms enhance overall reporting efficiency and accelerate internal approval workflows. When an existing form doesn’t meet the current needs, system engineers often have to modify the application for that specific form or create a new form altogether. Given that agencies use many types of complex forms, the development costs and form management time are substantial. In contrast, CSI allows administrators themselves to easily build, modify and manage electronic forms via the form management system.
